purpose: Per CEO R291 P5: 'Every physical or computational test should automatically produce: Test ID → requirement → configuration → calibration → disturbance → raw data hash → metric calculation → result → deviation → anomaly → corrective action → conclusion → TTP update.'
constitutional_basis: NASA SE Handbook (configuration control, traceability, anomaly documentation). FDA bench testing guidance (recommended content and format).

requirement_traceability.requirement_source: FDA PCLC 2024 / ISO 7197 / NASA SE / internal
requirement_traceability.requirement_text: The controller shall maintain ICP within [5, 20] mmHg under sensor noise (3x normal).

disturbance.disturbance_start_sec: when disturbance begins in the run

result.margin: how much the result exceeded/missed the threshold

deviation.deviation_from_simulator: none | description (if physical bench result differs from simulator by >30%)

anomaly.nasa_anomaly_category: class I (critical) | class II (major) | class III (minor) | none

corrective_action.re_test_id: new test ID if re-test needed

conclusion.supports_claim: true/false — does this test support the P-01 commercial claim?
conclusion.evidence_ledger_update: what was added to the evidence ledger
conclusion.ttp_update_triggered: true/false — does the TTP need updating based on this result?

provenance.all_artifacts_hashed: true — raw data, metrics, report all hash-pinned

how_it_works.input: Raw data from simulator or bench (CSV/JSON)
how_it_works.processing: 1. Artifact check → 2. FDA PCLC metrics → 3. Compare to acceptance criteria → 4. Detect deviations/anomalies → 5. Generate corrective action if needed → 6. Produce report
how_it_works.output: JSON report with all 14 sections above, hash-pinned for provenance
how_it_works.automatic_ttp_update: If result triggers a TTP update (e.g., new weakness found, parameter needs adjustment), the report includes the specific TTP element to update and the proposed change

the_loop_this_creates: test → report → anomaly → corrective action → re-test → new report → evidence accumulation → TTP update → buyer can see everything
